resources.string: Loaded into the system prompt at the start of each agent turn.
Memory reads and writes performed by the agent during this session.
Remove this memory entry from the daily log? This cannot be undone.
Entry not found in recent daily logs.
Persistent instructions and preferences visible to the agent in every session. The agent cannot modify this file.
Release %1$s is published but doesn\'t include an APK.
This build is for feature testing and may contain unfinished work. Preview data is isolated from the stable app.
These preview features have reached a stable baseline. This package keeps the separate preview app and its isolated data.
Allow installs from this app to continue.
Failed to launch installer. Check \"install unknown apps\" permission or open the downloaded APK manually.
Tip: If installation gives no feedback, the signature may not match — uninstall the previous version first, then download again.
Shows status of running agent sessions.
Reminds you to grant the system overlay permission so the background task overlay can appear.
Grant "Display over other apps" to let Novex show the current tool while you switch to another app. Tap to open the permission screen.
When exempted, Android won\'t put the app to sleep mid-task. Re-checked on each return to this screen.
Tap to allow Novex to run uninterrupted
Some Android skins (%1$s) require an extra autostart permission on top of the standard system settings. Without it, Novex can be killed within minutes of going to background.
Configure which models the agent uses, manage API keys & OAuth for each provider, and create model groups for fallback or load balancing.
Manage AI agent skills and instructions
Default system prompt for every conversation
This global preset is used by default in every conversation. Character cards, player personas, and world rules are layered separately for each new chat.
Describe how the agent should sound, think, and behave…
Over limit: %1$d / %2$d chars. Chinese ≤ %2$d chars or English ≤ %3$d words.
Over limit: %1$d / %2$d words. Chinese ≤ %3$d chars or English ≤ %2$d words.
Your current changes will be overwritten with the default personality file. The original is provided as a starting point and can be re-edited at any time.
Let every soul become a creator.
Toggle skills for this session only. Defaults come from Settings → Skills.
Choose up to 3 models for your default group.
Office documents preview in an external viewer.
%1$d sessions will move back to the main list. No session will be deleted.
The group and its %1$d sessions will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
Rename to something else, or tap to use it
The connection dropped — this reply may be incomplete. Tap Retry to continue.
Override the system appearance for this app.
Presets, accent, background, and text colors
Changes stay on this page until you save. Cancel or go back to discard them.
Novex uses the selected colors for pages, controls, links, and chat surfaces.
A preset changes both light and dark colors. You can fine-tune either mode afterwards.
Used for selected controls, buttons, links, and progress indicators.
Contrast is readable in both light and dark modes.
%1$s text does not have enough contrast against its background.
%1$s accent does not have enough contrast against its background.
Couldn’t save the theme. Your draft is still here; try again.
Enter a six-digit color such as #528AD2.
Choose whether the Return key in the chat input inserts a newline or sends the message. Hardware Shift+Return always inserts a newline.
Prevent the screen from sleeping while any session is running a task. May increase battery drain.
When on, the chat top bar and floating controls fade out after 6 seconds of inactivity. When off, they only hide when you tap empty space.
Show a sticky title pill while scrolling
Display the current session title as a floating pill at the top of the chat while scrolling through history.
File new chats into a matching group
When a chat\'s title is first generated, also file it into a matching existing group. Runs once per chat, only uses groups you already created, and leaves the chat ungrouped when nothing matches.
Show a live preview thumbnail alongside the tool status bar during agent execution.

When on, the keyboard pops up automatically after the model finishes replying so the input is ready for a follow-up. On by default; turn off if you prefer to read the response without an unexpected keyboard.
When on, a new thinking block expands automatically while the model is reasoning and collapses when it finishes. When off, thinking blocks stay collapsed — tap one to read it.
Scale fonts for chat input, message content, and general app text. Changes apply immediately.
Override the display language for this app. \"System\" follows your device language.
Change the launcher icon. The home-screen icon may take a few seconds to refresh after a tap.
When enabled, all console output is captured to daily log files in the app\'s private storage.
Tap a file to view its contents. Logs rotate daily.
This will delete %1$s of log files. This action cannot be undone.
Per-session toggles (set via the /memory slash command or the Session Memory sheet) override this default. Existing sessions are not affected when you flip this switch.
When off, new sessions skip GLOBAL.md and daily memory by default
Memory files store persistent knowledge across sessions. Edit GLOBAL.md to add instructions visible to the agent.
GLOBAL.md contains persistent instructions visible to the agent. Daily logs are created automatically during conversations.
This will permanently remove this memory log.
Skills extend the AI agent with specialized instructions and workflows. They are loaded into the system prompt when enabled.
Tap + to import a SKILL.md, .zip, or .skill file.
This will permanently remove the skill and its files.
Enter the URL of a SKILL.md file (GitHub links supported).
Paste the contents of a SKILL.md file. Must include YAML frontmatter with \'name\' field.
Select a .md, .zip, or .skill file from your device.
Invalid SKILL.md or skill already exists
Invalid SKILL.md. Ensure YAML frontmatter with \'name:\' field.
SKILL.md missing or invalid on disk
Removes all files generated by this session. The conversation itself will be preserved.
Add a provider to get started.
Shared content expired. Please share again.
This JSON file looks like an exported provider. What would you like to do?
Content saved. Couldn\'t open Novex automatically — please open the app to continue.
Hidden models won\'t appear in the model picker.
Restores the provider-reported display name and token limits, and un-hides the model.
This is a custom model. The Model ID is editable.
Built-in model. Display Name overrides the provider default.
Context window and max output tokens (in tokens). Leave empty to use provider defaults. Enable Thinking for models that support extended reasoning.
Exceeds provider-reported limit (%1$d). The value is saved but may cause errors.
Text input is always supported. Disable modalities the model cannot accept to avoid sending unsupported attachments.
Enable for models that generate images or audio (e.g. gpt-image-1, TTS). Text output is always available.
Run a quick test matching this model\'s main capability.
This model\'s provider doesn\'t support image generation via Quick Test.
The label shown in the model picker. Saved automatically when you tap elsewhere.
Applied automatically when a new session is bound to this group.
Groups let you combine models for fallback or load balancing.
Primary is used for main agent tasks. Sub is used for lightweight tasks like title generation. If Sub is not set, it inherits from Primary.
Models and providers inside the group will be kept.
Models and providers inside the group will be kept. These bindings will be cleared: %1$s.
Model ID is the API identifier sent to %1$s. Display Name is the friendlier label shown in the picker; defaults to Model ID when left blank.
Delete “%1$s”? Models and providers inside the group will be kept; any default, voice, vision, agent-loop, or image-generation binding that uses this group will be cleared. This cannot be undone.
Notify when an agent task finishes while the app is in the background. Shows progress in the notification shade and on the lock screen.
Notifies when an agent session finishes while the app is backgrounded.
Tap to open the chat and read the response.
Task ended with an error. Tap to open the chat.

Show a small floating capsule with the current tool while Novex is in the background. Requires permission to display over other apps. Tap the capsule to bring Novex to the foreground; drag to move it.
Allow drawing over other apps to enable
Show live agent status on the Android 16 status chip. When on, this replaces the floating overlay so you don\'t see two status indicators at once.
Your current system version doesn\'t support Live Updates yet (requires Android 16+ with the feature enabled).
Models and groups listed here can be invoked from the terminal via minis-model-use. Only these are visible to the agent.
All eligible models are already added.
A task is running in this chat. Starting a new chat will stop it.
Conversation context is nearly full. Compact the history to free up space before sending. Enabling auto-compact will do this automatically from now on.
Enhanced Cache extends Anthropic\'s prompt cache from 5 minutes to 1 hour, keeping context warm for longer sessions. This may add extra cache-write charges. Enable it?
All models are already in this group.
This message and every reply after it will be removed. Earlier messages and chat files are kept.
These directories are visible inside the Linux sandbox. Skills and Memory are maintained by AI agent tools — do not edit manually.
Clear all messages in this session
Bind this session to a group for automatic fallback or load balancing.
No models linked to this group.
Configure providers in Settings to see models here.
This model may not work as an Agent
%1$s outputs %2$s and usually can\'t drive an Agent task. Pick a text-output model for the session, or add this model to an Agent loop as a tool so the agent can call it on demand to generate %3$s.
A space for conversations and creation
Start a draft now; connect a model before sending
Enter an OpenAI-compatible API address and key
Choose the models you want to use
